name: Mr. Williams' Mistaken Missus
overview: Intern Audrey accidentally had a night with CEO Hunter Williams. But left  her friend Jennifer' resume behind while she leave. Jennifer took the opportunity to impersonate Audrey.Unexpectedly, Audrey, with her plain appearance, is promoted to personal secretary by Hunter. As they spend more time together, Hunter suspects she may be the one at that night.As Audrey navigates her new role, Jennifer attempts to seduce Hunter and rid herself of Audrey for good. Through wit and determination, Audrey foils Jennifer's plots. Audrey and Hunter discover that true love was right in front of them all along.
